rules.detail: Duplicate and suppression STOP ahead of reply, deal, follow-up, and terminal handling.
closed, closed_manual, dead, and a closed deal all STOP with TERMINAL_STATUS.
Replies hand off before follow-up scheduling; unsubscribe stops and out-of-office waits.
Active-deal statuses STOP without any outbound action.
Template mode generates only when the template and its required data are both present.
Personalised mode researches first, then generates, and stops when no address exists.
A pending initial pitch is sent, never regenerated; email_ready without content needs review.
Day 6 waits, day 7 sends follow-up 1, measured from the initial send.
Follow-up 2 is due at 14 days from the initial send, not from follow-up 1.
Follow-up 3 is due at 21 days from the initial send.
Reactivation is measured 60 days from the initial send; disabled reactivation ends the sequence instead.
Day 13 after reactivation waits; day 14 marks the lead dead.
Unresolved email_sync_failed sends always stop for review instead of resending.
Null-category leads never reach template generation (94 sampled instances).
GENERATE_FOLLOWUP does not exist; follow-ups are a single send action carrying contentReady.
Template-ready leads generate deterministically with no AI step (6 sampled instances).
